title: IDOR in Customer Routes - GET /customers/:id
description: The GET /api/v1/customers/:id endpoint in the vulnerable API lacks ownership validation. The vulnerableRequireRole middleware allows CUSTOMER role to access the endpoint, but there is no ownership check to verify that the requesting customer owns the requested customer resource. Any authenticated CUSTOMER can access any other customer's data by simply providing a different customer ID in the URL path.
impact: Cross-customer data exfiltration. A malicious customer can enumerate and access all other customers' personal information including name, phone, email, birth date, and notes by simply changing the customer ID in the URL.
mitigation: Implement ownership validation middleware (checkCustomerAccess) that verifies the requesting customer's userId matches the requested customer's userId, or that the user has ADMIN/BARBER role with appropriate permissions. Compare with secure implementation in customer_routes_secure.ts which uses checkCustomerAccess middleware.
